promise: Turn observed recurring agent mistakes into small cues only when evidence supports their use.
audience: People evaluating and improving recurring agent behavior.
trigger: Investigate a repeated correction or evaluate a proposed behavioral cue.

modes.name: Observe
modes.output: Consented structural observations and a falsifiable cue hypothesis.

modes.name: Assess
modes.when: A candidate cue has probe cases.
modes.output: A paired evidence record including no-effect and uncertainty.

modes.name: Maintain
modes.when: A cue is active, stale or harmful.
modes.output: An evidence-gated lifecycle decision and traceable ledger state.

examples.title: Fictional worked example
examples.before: A one-off correction becomes a permanent prompt rule with no control group.
examples.after: A small cue remains proposed until paired probes support a useful effect.
examples.why: No-effect and inconclusive records can prevent unsupported prompt growth.

boundaries: A minimum sample count and passing gate are not independent proof of efficacy or generalization.

verification.name: Functional acceptance
verification.expected: Supplied fictional tasks exercise actual mechanisms and failure boundaries.
verification.evidence: 58 native ledger/tool tests passed plus 3 standalone functional checks.

verification.name: Native host acceptance
verification.expected: Actual provider/host/desktop/daemon/runner acceptance for the selected adapter.
verification.evidence: No live model, real desktop transaction, invitation, deployment or production data migration was performed by this functional baseline.

sources.role: Primary retained owner history, mechanisms and records; portable method consolidates the listed entry points.

consolidation: One portable method entry with mode references; original native engines, agents and records retained as optional adapters.
